title: "agent-orchestration: a review range over 8 MiB fails as 'Cannot produce the complete task diff', hiding the size cause"
epic: "EP-019"
acceptance: [{"text":"The review patch is streamed to the request's patch file (or buffered under an explicit, documented cap well above 8 MiB) so a 9.1 MB range with binary files produces a reviewable request; patch_sha256 still covers exactly what the reviewer receives.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T15:02:20.414Z"},{"text":"When the diff cannot be produced, the refusal names the real cause: size over the cap (with the size and the cap), git's exit code and stderr, or a missing revision; never only the generic sentence.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T15:02:20.514Z"},{"text":"Binary files are represented in the reviewer patch as path, old and new blob sha256 and size rather than their bytes, with the manifest covered by patch_sha256; text diffs are unchanged; the reviewer prompt explains the manifest.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T15:02:20.616Z"},{"text":"Tests: a range with more than 8 MiB of binary files yields a request; a forced git failure yields a specific error; the manifest lists each binary file with its hash.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T15:02:20.713Z"}]
evidence: [".bytedesk/task-management/evidence/TM-241-topology-reviewer-test-output.txt",".bytedesk/task-management/evidence/TM-288-board-review.md",".bytedesk/task-management/evidence/TM-241.json"]
